17. C. physical change because the space between crystals is adjusted. 1
No new substance is formed in this process, only the spacing between
crystals changes that alters the wavelength of light reflected.

[CBSE Class X Science, sample question paper, 2026-27]
17. Chameleons contain crystals that reflect light and produce colour. Adjusting the
spacing between these crystals, they can alter the wavelengths of light reflected, 1
thus changing their skin colour. Based on the above information, we can infer
that the change in colour by chameleons is a:
A. chemical change because change in colour takes place.
B. chemical change because wavelength of reflected light changes.
C. physical change because the space between crystals is adjusted.
D. physical change because light is reflected by crystals.

items.stem: Which of the following changes can be reversed?
A chameleon changes its skin colour by adjusting the spacing between crystals in its skin. What type of change is this?
A student heats a piece of glass and then bends it. What type of change is this?
Which of the following is an example of a physical change?
Which of the following is an example of a physical change?
Which of the following is a reversible change?
Which of the following is an example of a slow change?
A chameleon can change its skin color by adjusting the spacing between crystals in its skin. Based on this, what type of change is the color change?
Which of the following is an example of a natural change?
In a science experiment, a student added dilute HCl to Zn granules and observed a reaction. What two observations would indicate that a chemical change has occurred?
A student observed that a dry handkerchief gets wet quickly when dipped in water, but a wet handkerchief takes time to dry. What is the reason for this?
Which of the following is an example of a physical change?
A student places a copper wire in a solution of silver nitrate. After some time, a layer of silver forms on the wire. What type of change is this?
A chameleon changes its skin color by adjusting the spacing between crystals in its skin. What type of change is this?
A student observes that when a piece of iron is kept in a damp place, it forms a reddish-brown layer. What is the main reason for this change?
A student heats a mixture of iron filings and sulfur. After heating, a black compound is formed. What can be concluded about this change?
Which of the following is a reversible change?
Which of the following is an example of a chemical change?
Which of the following is an example of a physical change?
A student heats sugar in a dish and observes it turning black. What type of change is this?
Which of the following changes is both a physical and a chemical change?
In a science experiment, a student heats a piece of sugar in a dish and observes it turning black. What is the best explanation for this change?
If a piece of iron is painted, what is the main purpose of this action?
A student observes that a piece of metal changes color when exposed to air. What can be inferred about the change?
